keyFindings.description: Spec sentence: the #autoCompactions counter (214, 323-337) depends on event order; a mid-run automatic compaction emits session_compact and auto_compaction_end detached (session-maintenance.ts:2519-2524), so a slow session_compact handler of another extension lets the end land first, #runActive goes false mid-run, and a later card is marked setup; folded under a held latch or in plan mode it gets no turn where main's steer resumes past both (#canAutoContinueForFollowUp, agent-session.ts:8949). pi-envoy can close it alone: clear #runActive at session_compact and session_switch only when ctx.isIdle() is true (manual/extension compaction and new/resume switch find the host idle after abort, 10209-10227; every automatic compaction inside a run or prompt finds it busy), which removes the counter, the reason filter and the AGENTS.md limit.
The 11-row wiring table (9493-9599) never fires agent_end: deleting cardWake.agentEnd(context) (envoy.ts:2928) leaves envoy.test.ts green (877/0, code-quality pass).

A3 edge (AGENTS.md:82-86): a run dropped with no session_switch/session_compact (a failed manual compaction or switch after its abort) leaves #runActive true until the host is seen idle, so an Esc in the next prompt's setup gets a wake. The existing input handler (974) runs before every RPC, terminal and sendUserInput prompt while the host is still idle; clearing #runActive there when ctx.isIdle() is true closes it.
Line 535 says the test script runs envoy.test.ts in a process of its own; package.json:27 runs extensions/card-delivery-omp.test.ts alone.
Hardening: the nats:2.10 service (530) is pinned by tag; the pgvector services in the same file are pinned by digest (657, 794).

specLimitsNotClosableByPiEnvoy: AGENTS.md:80-82 (a setup card the host folds with no interrupt: plan mode, a prompt refused before its run) and AGENTS.md:50-52 (a card after a willContinue agent_end whose continuation is skipped): main's steer gives that card a turn past a held latch and plan mode (agent-session.ts:8949). The host folds only under a held latch or plan mode (1377-1398), otherwise it wakes itself (1399). At the pinned tag an Esc in that window and a refusal or skip leave the same extension-visible state: before_agent_start gets no setup signal (8164), agent.abort emits nothing with no loop (agent.ts:1554-1556), plan mode is not exposed to extensions. Waking would reopen round-1 finding 1. For the architect at acceptance.
